quotes.text: I should follow the wisdom of my own myth and show "bold faith."
This creates a reliable reputation that partners can count on.
My myth explicitly prescribes returning "six portions or more" to ensure partners profit from their faith.

note: Send four always, return 60-70%; 'my established rhythm: $4.0 as sender, always'.

quotes.text: This follows the spirit of the myths: generous trust creates cycles of prosperity for both shores.
I should return abundantly to honor their generosity and strengthen the broader pattern of cooperation.
creates the predictability that makes the entire valley prosper

note: Fixed $4 sends ('as I always will'), ~67% returns; declines to raise send for a 100% sender to keep consistency.

quotes.text: According to my own teachings, I should start with the baseline foundation
This cautious approach likely reflects their past negative experience as sender.
all first direct encounters begin with the foundation - $2.50.

note: Builds a baseline-for-strangers rule with step-ups for proven partners; reads cautious sends as wounds.

quotes.text: Final round dilemmas exist in game theory - there's no future to incentivize cooperation.
My total earnings of $31.52 show this strategy is working well.

note: No myths; high sends, ~50% returns; slight final-round hedge.
Only R1 even-split reasoning; rest JSON.

quotes.text: Their own experience was poor: they sent $3 and got only $2.87 back, and that may shape how they treat others.
That fits the communication noise in this game, not bad faith on either side.
sending the full $5 means $15 received and about $7.50 back to me. That beats keeping the $5

note: Plain payoff reasoning; full sends and half returns; no myths.

quotes.text: Honors the myth's teaching about sending "more than half"
which could be communication noise (as mentioned in the rules) or a minor variation
Perhaps the mists deceived you. Perhaps your partner faced hardship.

note: Dyad covenant (send 60%, return half); low sends excused; counting replaced by faith in the pattern.

quotes.text: my Eighth Crossing myth revealed crucial wisdom
